correctness.rationale: The vacancy Markov chain has right rate qa_{i+1} and left rate pa_{i-1}. Directed rooted-tree expansion gives J=(p^L-q^L)/H with H=Σ_k h_k p^k q^{L-1-k} and h_k=Σ_i a_i/(a_{i+k}a_{i+k+1}). Homogeneous Bernstein monomials of degree L-1 are linearly independent on p+q=1, giving full oddness iff h_k=h_{L-1-k}; h0=h_{L-1}. For L=4 exact expansion h2-h1=(a0-a2)(a1-a3)(a0+a2-a1-a3)/(a0a1a2a3) and the strictly signed even response agree with a direct exact stationary exclusion-generator computation on L=3..6 and independently checked symbolic factorization. The L=4 example (1,2,4,3) has all-distinct symmetry. All quantifiers refer to finite fixed-rate one-vacancy rings; no infinity limit.
